name: India directories
description: Indian consumer, B2B, jobs, real-estate and map directories (JustDial, Zomato, Swiggy, Sulekha, Urban Company, MagicBricks, NoBroker, Naukri, 99acres, travel sites, BookMyShow, Mappls, IndiaMART, Udaan, Practo, Lybrate, ShareChat).
warning: Most are Tier C: they only work through the browser backend (`LEADSCOUT_BROWSER`) and a second switch (`LEADSCOUT_INDIA_TIER_C=1`). Mappls is Tier B and needs `MAPPLS_API_KEY`. Directory sites commonly forbid scraping in their terms.
